audits.text:
## c99f630b7541

**Reproduced dead controls and schema/runtime mismatch.** Generator `2.0.0`
advertises boolean axes `asymmetry` and `anchor_corner`, but never reads either.
With source SHA-256
`31fec815826e1c811faa689168d33194cf12e385e47dc728912cd1f3cea07c71`,
seed `audit-dead-controls`, difficulty `medium`, and sample indices 0–99,
`(False,False)` and `(True,True)` produced **100/100 byte-identical pairs**;
all 100 paired inputs passed `self_check`.

The same generator declares both `n_eights` and `n_twos` valid on `1..8`, while
its eager `ctx.draw_int(..., 2, 4)` calls reject exact values outside `2..4`.
The probe attempted `1,5,6,7,8` for each axis and reproduced **10/10 advertised
values rejected** with `ValueError`.

The representative lawful input is in
`checks/audit/c99f630b7541/input.json`. Its selected canonical Racket output is
valid and bound to the audited generator hash and rule hash `b446902efab5` in
`checks/audit/c99f630b7541/racket.json`. The full collision/domain probe and
commands are in `checks/audit/c99f630b7541/audit_record.json`.

This is an audit-only finding; the target generator was not edited.

## c99f630b7541

**Reproduced the existing unresolved dead-control/domain finding.** Audited source SHA-256: `31fec815826e1c811faa689168d33194cf12e385e47dc728912cd1f3cea07c71`.

Changing both advertised booleans `asymmetry` and `anchor_corner` from false to true produced **100/100 byte-identical paired inputs** under fixed seeds; all generated inputs passed `self_check`. The generator also advertises `n_eights` and `n_twos` as `1..8`, but exact values `1,5,6,7,8` were rejected for each axis by the hidden 2–4 draw domain: **10/10 advertised trials failed**.

This independently reproduces the retained prior audit against the unchanged current source; it does not close that finding or approve a repair. Exact evidence: `checks/audit/c99f630b7541/audit_record.json`; representative input: `checks/audit/c99f630b7541/input.json`; common probe: `checks/audit/probe_audits.py`. Audit only; source not edited. Canonical Racket-label correctness was not reassessed in this control-contract probe.
